top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a distinct and mature discovery: the Z2 classification of insulators by band topology, predicted by Kane and Mele and realised in HgTe quantum wells by Molenkamp, with two decades of independent confirmation by transport, ARPES and STM. It is separable from the 2016 prize, which concerned topological phases in model systems. The attribution gap (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan) is real but a narrow citation limited to the quantum spin Hall state and its first realisation claims no more than the trio delivered. P002 has the cleaner credit boundary but a thinner discovery content and a close overlap with the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes, so it ranks second; an award is still preferable to no award.
